messages:
Maria Chen: Thanks for the all-hands earlier. Quick clarifying Qs for leadership on KMS/BYOK, VPC/private connectivity, and audit evidence for SOC2/ISO. Pinging @Vikram @Emily. Topline questions:
1) Cross-account BYOK (customers bring key from their KMS) — timeline for Dedicated and Private?
2) Key rotation windows / automated rollover support?
3) Audit log export — push to customer SIEM (syslog/S3/Kafka)?
4) For ISO and SOC2 evidence, what artifact packages will customers get and when? Trying to collect answers for a customer RFP today. :wave:

Vikram Rao: Thanks Maria — good list. Short answers: 1) Cross-account BYOK: Scoped PRD done. Pilot for Dedicated in late Q2; GA for Dedicated targeted Q3. Private (VPC/on-prem) will follow with an adapter pattern in Q4.
2) Rotation: we'll support manual import of rotated keys today; automated rotation and rollover (grace window + double-encrypt) planned for Q3.
3) Audit export: we will support S3 push for hosted logs and a push-to-Syslog/Kafka connector for Dedicated/Private in Q3.
4) Evidence: Emily can confirm details — we'll provide SOC2 Type II report, ISO control mappings, and a per-customer evidence bundle in Console. Owners: @Jess (audit exports), @Emily (compliance), @Vikram (KMS).

Emily Nguyen: Confirming — compliance deliverables: SOC2 Type II report (annual), ISO-27001 certificate + control mapping sheets, and a downloadable evidence package for Dedicated/Private customers (contains config snapshots, IAM mappings, KMS policies, audit log extracts). We expect evidence-bundle feature in Console as beta by end of Q3. For customers needing continuous evidence, we can provide export hooks (S3 or SFTP) as an enterprise add-on. :lock:

Jess Ortega: Quick product notes — Dedicated pilot means customers in our reserved pools can test BYOK cross-account flow. For Private, pattern is: customer KMS in their account/VPC -> we validate via signing challenge -> we never import private key material. Implementation details: <https://redwood.internal/docs/kms-arch>.

Ops Bot: Deployment plan doc posted: <https://redwood.internal/docs/kms-roadmap|KMS roadmap> and office hours signup: <https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours|Office hours signup>.

Samir Patel: To add — for rotation we will ship a 'key-rotation-mode' that supports 'manual', 'scheduled', and 'automatic-rollover'. SLA implications: auto-rollover requires Dedicated or Private due to KMS access model. We'll include a migration path for existing customers. I'll set up a follow-up deep dive next week. :calendar:

Maria Chen: Thanks — can you also clarify audit retention windows? Customer asked for 2 years retention for audit logs.

Vikram Rao: Current retention defaults: hosted = 90 days indexed, 365 days raw archival (S3). Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention up to 5 years on their export. We'll add UI controls in Console (Q3) and document retention/export costs.

Emily Nguyen: Note for ISO: 2-year retention may be fine for logs but check the specific control. We'll provide a retention policy template for customers to use in their own compliance program.

Jess Ortega: Action items: 1) Publish KMS/BYOK pilot sign-up (me) 2) Add audit-export connector spec (me) 3) Compliance evidence sample (Emily) 4) Schedule office hours (Samir). I'll post a short PRD and timeline by EOD Monday. :memo:

Maria Chen: Awesome — please @mention here when the PRD and office hours are up. Also if someone can drop a short snippet for customers showing how to configure S3 export that would be great.

Ops Bot: Example config snippet posted in docs:
```json
{
  "export": "s3",
  "bucket": "customer-audit-${account}",
  "encrypt": true,
  "retention_days": 730
}
```

Vikram Rao: Will follow up here with dates. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
